title: VPC Preflight Simulation & Policy Prober for Private Installs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement a deterministic preflight simulation and policy prober that runs against a customer's Private (VPC) install configuration before we attempt deployment. The goal is to synthesize a single pass/fail and diagnostic report that combines terraform plan validation, cloud quota queries, IAM policy validation, DNS and network probing, and GPU SKU availability checks. This ticket covers: 1) a simulation runner that consumes a Terraform plan output and a minimal inventory (region, account id, vpc cidr) and mirrors the steps of the installer; 2) a policy prober that executes safe, read-only cloud API checks and lightweight probes (DNS resolution, route table walk, NAT egress check); 3) a deterministic scoring and remediation guidance layer (e.g., which quota to request, IAM roles to add, DNS TTL issues) that the on-call engineer or customer SRE can action; and 4) integration points for the Console preflight UI and the Private onboarding flow (upload plan -> run simulation -> present report). Emphasis is on safe read-only operations, idempotent simulations, and producing actionable remediation steps rather than opaque errors.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation runner accepts terraform plan (JSON) + inventory and produces a reproducible report in <= 90s for typical medium-sized account
Preflight report includes categorized failures (quota, iam, dns, gpu, network) with at least one suggested remediation per failure
All cloud checks use read-only APIs or test endpoints; no changes are made to customer accounts
Automated integration tests cover at least 5 positive and 8 failure scenarios (quota too low, missing iam role, CNAME resolution issue, unsupported GPU SKU, insufficient subnet IPs)
Console shows the preflight run status, top-3 failures, and a link to the detailed prober trace
Ensure results are reproducible across repeated runs for the same inputs (no flakiness >1%)
implementation_steps: Prototype simulation runner: consume `terraform show -json` and map resources relevant to installer (subnets, route tables, nat gateways, security groups)
Build quota checker modules for AWS/GCP/Azure using paginated quota APIs and compare against expected capacity (vCPU, ENI, EIP, subnet IPs, GPU SKUs)
Implement IAM static analysis: detect missing managed policies, deny statements, and cross-account trust gaps using policy simulator where available

Add DNS & network prober: perform conditional DNS resolution, traceroute-like path checks inside VPC using a short-lived probe instance or existing VPC endpoints (read-only methods only), and validate private hosted zone association
Create GPU SKU availability probe that queries regional capacity hints (preferred instance families and known availability zones) and flags risky SKUs with suggested fallbacks
Design the scoring and remediation engine: map failure types to remediation templates and a confidence score
Add CI harness and scenario-based integration tests using recorded cloud responses (VCR) and a small sandbox account
Expose API endpoint and wire to Console preflight workflow with run history and downloadable JSON report
Document runbook and copy remediation templates to Confluence; add to Private onboarding checklist
preflight_checks: Terraform plan parsing: resource coverage and unsupported resource detection
Quota: vCPUs, ENIs, Elastic IPs, GPU quota, load balancers, NAT gateway limits
IAM: required roles/policies present, role trust, inline deny rules, S3/Bucket policies for model artifacts
DNS: private hosted zone exists and is associated with target VPC, delegation records resolve from inside VPC
Network: route table entries to NAT/IGW, subnet CIDR size check vs expected pod/instance density
GPU availability: regional SKU capacity hints and suggested alternatives
Egress/internet access tests for installer downloads (S3, model tarballs) using safe HTTP HEAD checks
KMS and key policy visibility: verify KMS key exists and account has decrypt/describe permission (read-only verification)
Upgrade path checks: current installed runtime version vs target and known breaking changes (from release notes)
test_plan: Create 5 golden terraform plans (small, medium, large, GPU-limited, misconfigured DNS) for integration tests
Record cloud API responses in a sandbox and use them with VCR-style fixtures to avoid flakiness in CI
Introduce mutation tests that flip a single piece of config (remove IAM role OR reduce quota) and assert the prober reports the single root cause
Run nightly end-to-end validation against a dedicated sandbox account to detect drift in cloud APIs or transient failures
Add chaos scenarios: intermittent quota API errors, DNS timeouts, and ensure report degrades gracefully with clear 'could not verify' labels
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dogfood runs on 3 existing Private customers (with their consent) and 1 Redwood sandbox account
Phase 1: opt-in beta exposed in Console for new Private installs with telemetry and feedback link
Phase 2: default preflight gating for all automated installs (soft-fail first 2 weeks, then enforce hard gating after metrics look stable)
Provide a rollback: ability to bypass preflight via explicit engineer override with audit log entry
Track metrics: preflight failure rate, top-5 failure categories, mean time to resolution after guidance
